name: Redvanly
why: Golf and racquet performance built around a pull-on waistband, sold from three of its own shops and a green-grass wholesale book.
origin: Andrew Redvanly, New York, 2013 — a family business that pioneered the pull-on trouser and still leads with it.
opview: Redvanly on the stretch waistband being imitated across the category: a compliment he takes as proof of relevance.

onething.n: verified — collection page opened; the house calls itself the originator of the pull-on trouser. Collection rather than a single SKU, because the model runs across fabrics. Kent lists at $150

notes.synth: named fabric platforms throughout — PUREpoly, GLYDINGnylon, STRETCHknit, CLIMATEcomfort
notes.golf: golf is the house register, with a separate racquet and athletics book beside it
notes.forg: the pull-on waistband is the whole proposition, not a feature
notes.racquet: a real racquet collection, but public-court technical rather than the club end this dial's upper reaches measure
notes.tech: thirty house-named fabrics for ordinary cloths: PUREpoly is polyester, ComfortChino is chino, Activedenim is denim. Naming is not technology

cities: Own shops in the West Village, West Palm Beach and Michigan · golf specialty and Golf Galaxy
